parents.name: The Father as Order
parents.text: Present through rules, money, and silence. Love was structure. You learned that being provided for and being seen are different things.

parents.name: The Devouring Mother
parents.text: Love that held too tight. Every danger narrated, every step watched. You learned to carry their fear before you could carry your own.

parents.name: The Hero-Maker
parents.text: You were their proof. Love arrived with achievement and left with failure. You became the family's myth and hid the child.

parents.name: The Absent God
parents.text: Gone, or there and not there. You built an image to talk to. The image became more real than the person.

parents.name: The Eternal Child
parents.text: A parent who never grew up. You heard adult secrets at nine and became the grown-up in the house.

parents.name: The Sacrificer
parents.text: Everything given, nothing said. Debt was the family's language. You learned that love is measured in what it costs.

parents.name: The Great Mother
parents.text: Nourishing, steady, unremarkable. Feelings had a place to land. You did not know it was rare until you left.

parents.name: The Shadow in the House
parents.text: Moods no one named. You became a reader of doors and footsteps. Your intuition was born as a survival skill.

schools.name: The big public school
schools.text: Buses, tests, a gifted track, and a lunch table that decided your rank.

schools.name: The small religious school
schools.text: Uniforms, prayer, one teacher who knew your whole family. Shame and belonging arrived together.

schools.name: The underfunded school
schools.text: Broken things, one great teacher who stayed, a library that closed early. You got sharp early.

schools.name: The elite school
schools.text: Everyone's parent was someone. You learned what money sounds like when it is quiet.

schools.name: The everyone-since-kindergarten school
schools.text: Forty-minute ride, same faces for twelve years. Leaving was the plan or the sin.

events.name: One adult saw you
events.text: A teacher, coach, or neighbor said one sentence you are still living up to.

events.name: Early responsibility
events.text: You raised a sibling or ran the house before you were twelve.

events.name: The move
events.text: A city, a country, a language. You arrived as the new kid and never fully unpacked.

events.name: Praise for one trait
events.text: Smart. Pretty. Strong. Funny. You became the trait and hid the rest.

events.name: The rupture
events.text: Divorce, a death, a departure. The house had a before and an after.

events.name: Public humiliation
events.text: One moment in front of everyone. You decided something about visibility that day.

events.name: First thing you loved alone
events.text: A book, a game, a sky. Nobody gave it to you and nobody could take it.

events.name: Money went away
events.text: A layoff, a lost house, a quiet downgrade. You learned to notice prices.

events.name: The secret
events.text: Something in the family nobody said out loud. You learned to hold what could not be held.

events.name: Being the translator
events.text: Between languages, between parents, between worlds. You became the bridge.

events.name: The win
events.text: A trophy, a scholarship, a stage. For one day the family story was about you, and it was good.

events.name: The illness
events.text: Yours or theirs. Waiting rooms. Learning that bodies can fail.

events.name: The friend who left
events.text: The first person you chose who chose someone else.

events.name: Caught and forgiven
events.text: You did the wrong thing, got caught, and were loved anyway. Repair became possible.

events.name: Caught and shamed
events.text: You did the wrong thing and it became who you were for a year. You learned to hide.

events.name: The long summer alone
events.text: Weeks with no one home. You built a world to live in.

events.name: The grandparent
events.text: One older person who had time. Their kitchen was the safest room in the world.

events.name: The comparison
events.text: A sibling or cousin who was the standard. You measured yourself in someone else's units.

events.name: The first no
events.text: You refused something everyone expected. It cost you and it made you.

events.name: Being needed
events.text: Someone relied on you and you liked it more than you should have. Usefulness became love.
